claims: All Target stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Normal operations and regular store hours (generally 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. or 11 p.m.) are expected to resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Target Store Locator lists Easter Sunday (April 5, 2026) as closed.
Target Store Locator lists Monday (April 6, 2026) as regular hours (generally 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. or 11 p.m.).
